_comment: Exploded view of pi5_dac_hat: the same parts moved up along z (standoffs +14, socket +24, HAT +50). Thin rods (explode lines) run through the 4 mounting-hole axes and the two end GPIO pin axes to show where each part attaches. RCA leads plug into the HAT (socket axis z 62.6 + 7.6 = 70.2) and lie down to the table at z 0; the USB-C lead plugs into the Pi.
